mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 100k signals rising household income and consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the Housing Starts Index below 1.2 million units signals weakening residential investment, which reduces GDP growth and drags S&P 500 returns lower over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST falls below 1.2m for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when HOUST < 1.2m for 2 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month contraction in the Industrial Production Index below 1% growth signals slowing manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO < 1% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in CPI above 2% signals tighter monetary policy expectations, which raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when CPI > 2% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5% signals labor market tightness, which raises wage pressures and leads to higher inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 5% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE < 5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in Real Personal Income above 1% signals weakening consumer purchasing power, which reduces demand and drags S&P 500 returns lower over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when RSAFS < -1% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the federal funds rate below 1% signals monetary policy constraints, which compresses the policy transmission channel and reduces the likelihood of positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls below 1% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS < 1% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
